assertions.evidence: The request sets questions.urgency.type to "score" with five ordered criteria (URGENCY_LEVELS), and the test asserts type === "score" and criteria.length === 5.

The code derives the sortable urgency via levelFromAnswer(answer), preferring answer.probabilities to pick a level 1–5 and falling back to rounding answer.score; it does not ask the model for a 1–5 value or make a second call.
The Decisions request uses separate named state fields: state: { service: incident.service.trim(), report: incident.report.trim() }.
